sign_branch_order: Try all 32 binary assignments to wires 416..420 in increasing integer order. No private sign information selects or orders a branch.
claim_boundary: Public-order enumeration of five lift-sign bits with all five planted factor masks already pinned. A solved branch is a positive circuit/group control only; it does not search factor masks or measure ordinary-query yield, DLP, rho, or speedup.
